title: Ghulam-E-Musthafa
desc: Musthafa, a contract killer, seeks to exit the world of crime after his wife, kavita, is accidentally murdered by his enemies. however, no matter how much he tries, his past soon catches up with him.

title: Do Numbri
desc: Raju, a petty thief, is on the path to reformation but decides to retaliate when he learns that his pregnant sister has been deserted by her lover arun and humiliated by his family.

title: Aadmi Khilona Hai
desc: Vijay and ganga live happily with vijay's brother sharad. when it is revealed that sharad's wife poonam cannot conceive, ganga makes the ultimate sacrifice and gives poonam her own child.

title: Purani Haveli
desc: Anita arrives at a haunted mansion along with sunil and a group of friends. after a series of deaths, sunil discovers the monster and finds out a way to kill him and save anita.

title: Bengal Tiger
desc: A dedicated police inspector, prashant verma, gets transferred to an area that is ruled by a powerful criminal, rukavat singh. after prashant's arrival, he strives to put an end to rukavat's misdeeds.
